title: Language Models Do Not Follow Occam’s Razor: A Benchmark for Inductive and Abductive Reasoning
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating logical reasoning capabilities (inductive and abductive) and the application of Occam's Razor (parsimony) in large language models. While the text uses the word 'moral' in a classic philosophical logic example, it does not evaluate religion, faith, ethics, or moral frameworks as a core component.
